title.en: Screenshot storage for issues filed from Discord
title.zh: Discord 回報 issue 的截圖存放區

description.en: Stores the screenshots for GitHub issues that the 自由工坊 Discord helper bot files after a reporter or admin confirms the draft. Discord attachment links expire; these copies stay until someone removes them.
description.zh: 存放自由工坊 Discord 小幫手 bot 開立 GitHub issue 時附上的截圖，回報者或管理員確認草稿後才會開立。Discord 附件連結會過期，這裡的副本會一直留著，直到有人移除。

eyebrow.en: Storage repo · 自由工坊 Discord
eyebrow.zh: 存放用 repo · 自由工坊 Discord

lede.en: When someone reports a problem in the 自由工坊 Discord, a helper bot drafts a GitHub issue. After the reporter or an admin confirms the draft, the bot strips each screenshot's metadata, commits it here, and links it from the issue.
lede.zh: 有人在自由工坊 Discord 回報問題時，小幫手 bot 會先擬好 GitHub issue 草稿。回報者或管理員確認之後，bot 會移除截圖的中繼資料、提交到這個 repo，再在 issue 裡附上連結。

meta.en: One screenshot, from Discord to the issue
meta.zh: 一張截圖，從 Discord 到 issue

title.en: Confirmed first, cleaned, filed by path.
title.zh: 先確認、再清理、照路徑歸檔。

intro.en: The repository holds images only. The bot that files the issues lives elsewhere.
intro.zh: 這個 repo 只放圖片，開 issue 的 bot 不在這裡。

title.en: Nothing lands before a person confirms
title.zh: 有人確認之後才會存進來

body.en: The bot drafts the issue in Discord first. Screenshots are committed here only after the reporter or an admin confirms that draft.
body.zh: bot 會先在 Discord 裡擬好 issue 草稿，等回報者或管理員確認之後，截圖才會提交到這裡。

title.zh: 每個檔案都有固定路徑

body.en: Files land at ///-.: the repository the issue was filed in, the month, the Discord draft ID, and the screenshot number.
body.zh: 檔案會存在 ///-.：依序是 issue 所在的 repo、月份、Discord 草稿編號和第幾張截圖。

body.en: Photos can carry EXIF data such as location and device details. The bot strips it before upload, and a check of the stored file on 2026-09-30 found no metadata.
body.zh: 照片可能帶有位置、裝置等 EXIF 資訊。bot 會在上傳前移除；2026-09-30 檢查存放的檔案，沒有找到任何中繼資料。

intro.en: Screenshots sometimes show more than intended, such as names, email addresses, or tokens. If a secret was exposed, rotate it first: deleting the image does not undo the exposure.
intro.zh: 截圖有時會拍到不該公開的東西，例如姓名、email 或 token。如果外洩的是密碼或金鑰，請先更換：刪掉圖片並不能讓外洩的資訊收回來。

body.en: Note the issue and the screenshot number, or the file path in this repository.
body.zh: 記下是哪個 issue、第幾張截圖，或是這個 repo 裡的檔案路徑。

body.en: Ask an admin in the 自由工坊 Discord. If you are not in the Discord, open an issue in this repository. Name the file; do not attach the image again.
body.zh: 在自由工坊 Discord 找管理員；不在 Discord 的話，就在這個 repo 開 issue。寫出檔案位置就好，不要再附一次圖片。

body.en: The file is deleted from main and the issue is edited to drop the link. Older commits still hold the file until the Git history is rewritten.
body.zh: 維護者會從 main 刪除檔案，並編輯 issue 拿掉連結。在改寫 Git 歷史之前，舊的 commit 裡仍然留有這個檔案。

intro.en: Set up in September 2026. So far it holds one screenshot, from a closed test issue.
intro.zh: 2026 年 9 月建立，目前只存了一張截圖，來自一個已關閉的測試 issue。

works.en: Screenshots stored by path and linked from issues through raw.githubusercontent.com
works.zh: 截圖依路徑存放，issue 透過 raw.githubusercontent.com 連結

works.en: EXIF stripped before upload; the stored file had no metadata when checked on 2026-09-30
works.zh: 上傳前移除 EXIF；2026-09-30 檢查存放的檔案，沒有任何中繼資料

works.en: This project page publishes only site/, never the stored images
works.zh: 專案介紹頁只發佈 site/，不會發佈存放的圖片

limits.en: The repository is public, so a confirmed screenshot is public too. Confirming the draft is the privacy check
limits.zh: repo 是公開的，確認過的截圖也就公開了；確認草稿那一步，就是隱私把關

limits.en: Deleting a file breaks the issue's image link but does not erase it from Git history
limits.zh: 刪除檔案會讓 issue 裡的圖片連結失效，但不會把它從 Git 歷史裡抹掉

limits.en: The bot's code is not in this repository
limits.zh: bot 的程式碼不在這個 repo 裡

heading.en: Nothing is public until someone confirms

intro.en: A report stays in Discord until a person confirms the draft. Confirming is what lets the screenshot into this public repository.
intro.zh: 回報會留在 Discord，直到有人確認草稿。確認這一步，才讓截圖進入這個公開倉庫。

note.en: Someone describes the problem in the 自由工坊 Discord, and the bot drafts an issue there.
note.zh: 有人在自由工坊 Discord 描述問題，bot 先在那裡擬好 issue 草稿。

note.en: The reporter or an admin confirms that draft. Nothing is committed here before that.
note.zh: 回報者或管理員確認草稿。在那之前，這裡不會提交任何截圖。

note.en: The bot strips EXIF, commits the image on main, and the issue links the raw URL.
note.zh: bot 去掉 EXIF，把圖提交到 main，issue 再連到 raw 網址。

ticks.zh: 確認過的圖就是公開的

caption.en: When someone reports a problem in the 自由工坊 Discord, the helper bot drafts a GitHub issue there. The screenshot is committed to this repository only after the reporter or an admin confirms that draft. The bot strips EXIF, commits the file on main, and the issue links it. The repository is public, so confirming the draft is the privacy check. The bot's code is not in this repository.
caption.zh: 有人在自由工坊 Discord 回報問題時，小幫手 bot 會先在那裡擬好 GitHub issue 草稿。截圖要等回報者或管理員確認之後，才會提交到這個 repo。bot 會去掉 EXIF，把檔提交到 main，issue 再連過去。這個 repo 是公開的，所以確認草稿就是隱私把關。bot 的程式不在這個 repo 裡。

intro.en: Every stored screenshot uses one path. The issue links that path on the main branch.
intro.zh: 每張存進來的截圖都走同一種路徑。issue 連的是 main 分支上的那個位置。

note.en: The first two folders name the repository the issue was filed in.
note.zh: 前兩層資料夾是這張 issue 所在的 repo。

note.en: The next folder is the year and the month, written as YYYY-MM.
note.zh: 下一層是年份和月份，寫成 YYYY-MM。

note.en: The file name is the Discord draft id, the screenshot number, and the extension.
note.zh: 檔名是 Discord 草稿編號、第幾張，再加上副檔名。

note.en: The issue links that file on main with a raw GitHub URL.
note.zh: issue 用 main 上的 raw GitHub 網址連到這個檔。

caption.en: A stored screenshot is filed at owner/repo/YYYY-MM/draft-id-n.ext: the repository the issue belongs to, the year and month, the Discord draft id, the screenshot number, and the extension. The issue links that file on the main branch through raw.githubusercontent.com. This project page is built from site/ only and does not publish the stored images.
caption.zh: 存進來的截圖路徑是 owner/repo/YYYY-MM/draft-id-n.ext：issue 所在的 repo、年份月份、Discord 草稿編號、第幾張，以及副檔名。issue 透過 raw.githubusercontent.com 連到 main 分支上的那個檔。這份專案介紹頁只從 site/ 建置，不會發佈存放的圖片。

intro.en: Removal deletes the file from main and drops the issue link. Older commits still hold the file until the history is rewritten.
intro.zh: 移除會從 main 刪掉檔案，並拿掉 issue 裡的連結。在改寫歷史之前，舊的 commit 裡還留著這個檔。

note.en: Name the issue and the screenshot number, or the path. Do not attach the image again.
note.zh: 寫出是哪張 issue、第幾張截圖，或檔案路徑。不要再附一次圖。

note.en: The maintainer deletes the file from the main branch.
note.zh: 維護者從 main 分支刪掉這個檔。

note.en: The issue is edited so it no longer links to that file.
note.zh: issue 會被改掉，不再連到這個檔。

note.en: Older commits still hold the file until someone rewrites the Git history.
note.zh: 在改寫 Git 歷史之前，舊的 commit 裡還有這個檔。

ticks.en: name the file, do not reattach
main loses the file and the link

caption.en: To take a screenshot down, name the issue and the screenshot number, or the path in this repository, and do not attach the image again. Ask an admin in the 自由工坊 Discord, or open an issue here if you are not in the Discord. The maintainer deletes the file from main and edits the issue to drop the link. If a password, token, or key is visible, rotate it first: deleting the image does not undo the exposure. Older commits still contain the file until the Git history is rewritten.
caption.zh: 要撤下截圖，請寫出是哪張 issue、第幾張，或這個 repo 裡的路徑，而且不要再附一次圖。在自由工坊 Discord 找管理員；不在 Discord 的話，就在這個 repo 開 issue。維護者會從 main 刪掉檔案，並編輯 issue 拿掉連結。如果畫面上看得到密碼、token 或金鑰，請先更換：刪掉圖片並不能讓外洩收回來。在改寫 Git 歷史之前，舊的 commit 裡仍然留有這個檔。
